note: Seven JPEGs are original Wikimedia Commons files reused as analogical incident-type context. They are not photographs of the Caraballeda sites, not screenshots, and not 2026 Caraballeda news-site images. W2 and W7 PNGs are AI-generated simulated drone verification renders tied to canonical OSM Sites for demo visualization only; they are not historical photographs and not ground truth. Operational interpretation still comes from StructuredObservation / IncidentFusion. Assets stay hidden until an event lists them in revealed_asset_ids. W9-W20 use unmodified, georeferenced post-event SkySat tiles (27 June 2026), Planet Labs PBC via HOTOSM/OpenAerialMap, CC BY-NC 4.0. These real neighborhood images are not drone photos and do not establish the simulated victim counts.

real: map geometry and building identities in the graph export
OSM names and facility types where present
Wikimedia Commons earthquake photographs reused as analogical incident-type context (not Caraballeda site matches)
W9-W20 georeferenced post-event satellite tiles; CC BY-NC 4.0, noncommercial reuse with attribution
simulated: operational interpretation of the drone finding
W2 / W7 AI-generated simulated drone verification imagery
disclosure.rule: W2 and W7 drone files are simulated_render with file_status available. They are demo artifacts tied to real OSM sites, not historical disaster photography and not ground truth. Contextual JPEGs are real_contextual_photo with specificity incident_type_level and is_exact_site_match false. If no file is bundled, file_status must be placeholder. Do not invent real-photo provenance for Caraballeda sites.
